def checked_config(config):
    c=json.loads(Path(config).read_text())
    require(set(c)=={'unit','output','argv','properties','pins','observation_s'},
            'Use the existing exact audit config; omit result_path and expected_tests')
    require(re.fullmatch(r'robotron-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.service',c['unit']), 'Exact audit service name required')
    props=dict(x.split('=',1) for x in c['properties'])
    require(len(props)==len(c['properties']) and props.get('CPUQuota')=='200%' and
        props.get('MemoryMax')=='4G' and props.get('RuntimeMaxSec')=='180' and
        set(props)<= {'CPUQuota','MemoryMax','RuntimeMaxSec','MemorySwapMax','TasksMax','TimeoutStopSec','SendSIGKILL'} and
        props.get('SendSIGKILL')=='no' and
        props.get('MemorySwapMax','0')=='0' and props.get('TasksMax','128') in ('128','256') and
        props.get('TimeoutStopSec','5')=='5','Audit resource scope differs')
    require(type(c['observation_s']) in (int,float) and 180<=c['observation_s']<=300,
            'Bounded original audit observation required')
    require(isinstance(c['argv'],list) and c['argv'] and all(isinstance(x,str) for x in c['argv']),
            'Explicit selected auditor argv required')
    return c

    require(re.fullmatch(r'robotron-compiled-startup32-integration-[a-z0-9_-]+\.service',c['unit']),
            'Exact private compiled startup32 namespace required')

        KillMode='mixed',SendSIGKILL='no'),'Exact bounded compiled32 resources required')
    require(type(c['observation_s'])is int and c['observation_s']==960,
            'Fixed original runtime/shutdown observation required')
    expected=['/home/dave/source/repos/ArcadeAI/.venv-gb300/bin/python','-Xgil=0','-I','-B',

    argv=c['argv']
    require(type(argv)is list and len(argv)==12 and argv[:5]==expected

        and all(type(v)is str for v in argv)
        and all(re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}',argv[i])for i in (9,11)),
        'Exact compiled32 original runtime argv required')
    job=Path(argv[7]);root=ROOT/'Robotron/logs/managed-learning-20261015/run-26'

        'Actual job and runtime must be in the original launch pins')
    return c
